rows.en: Hm? Oh, yeah, I guess it was fine?
What?! Which part was...

Ah, yeah, let's see...
Overall... it was good.
Well, I've got stuff to do, so clean up for me!
Th-thank you very much...
(Gary-sensei definitely wasn't watching...)

(We were supposed to meet at the simulator
again today, right...)
rows.notes: Female only; same as male c05235.

rows.en: (Gary-sensei definitely wasn't watching...)
(I was told to wait off campus today, but...)
Hey, you actually showed up!
Yes, but what are we doing today?

It's always training this, training that at school.
It gets stifling. So I figured today we'd
catch our breath somewhere relaxing.
Oh, is that so?
rows.notes: Shared by the player, Luca and Nanase in several scenes; neutral.

rows.en:
Yeah. Though if you're gonna come calling on me,
I kinda think you oughta go and pick up
a girl or something instead.
No, um, I was hoping to do some training...

Ugh, that's exactly what makes you a pain.
Be too serious and life'll suffocate you.
Loosen up a little.

Listen.
You're a student, and you're doing
plenty of stuff in class, right?
Uh, yes.

Then you just have to do that properly.
All that extra self-training and whatnot
will only wreck your concentration.
Is that how it works?

In class, you focus on class. When you play,
you play. Switching gears like that keeps
your focus sharp, no matter what you do.
Oh, I get it.

Plus, if you only ever do the same old stuff,
you'll end up a boring person.
Just look at Itsuki.
rows.notes: Both genders. Gary calls Yamashiro by his given name, bare.

rows.en:
I think Yamashiro-sensei is pretty amazing
in his own way, though...

Anyway, 'switch your mind on and off properly.'
That's where you start.
Okay, I'll keep that in mind.

Well,
from now on, I could teach you 'how to have fun.'
If you can't find anything to do, just come ask me.

Okay, thank you very much!
I can't believe you'd teach me all sorts of things
outside of school, too...
Ooh, that one's nice. About an 85, I'd say...
rows.notes: Both genders. Gary rating passers-by; kept as 'that one' (no gender stated).

rows.en:
Whoa! Now this one's perfect!
That's a 120, no question!
Sensei...
rows.notes: Shared by many scenes (Gary and Hilda); neutral.

rows.en:
Whoops, I just remembered I've got something to do.
Let's leave it here for today. See ya.
(Sensei... you're way too obvious...)
Oh, I see.

Yeah. Though if you've got time to fuss over me,
I kinda think you oughta go and catch yourself
a guy or something instead.
No, um, I was hoping to do some training...
Oh, I get it.

I think Yamashiro-sensei is pretty amazing
in his own way...
Okay! I'll keep that in mind.
(Sensei... you're so easy to read...)
(I was told to wait off campus again today, but...)

Does it matter?
Just hurry up and sit down.
No sense talking standing up, right?
rows.notes: Both genders. Answers the player's 'what are we doing today?'.

rows.en: Uh... okay...
And that's the deal. Got it?
rows.notes: Both genders. Wraps up an off-screen talk.

rows.en: I see... You might be right about that...
Well, don't think too hard about it. See ya!
Yes, thank you very much!
rows.notes: Shared by Gary and Hilda scenes; neutral.

rows.en:
(So Gary-sensei does say sensible stuff
once in a while...)
I see... You might really be right about that...

(So Gary-sensei does say sensible stuff
once in a while.)

(Gary-sensei said 'Today it's the Sky Gate!'...
Is something going on?)
Hey, glad you made it!

Sensei, you said the Sky Gate today...
What's going on?
You idiot! You came here without knowing anything?
Um, yes. You only told me yesterday, so...
rows.notes: Both genders. 'kinou no kyou': the invitation came only the day before.

rows.en:
Ahh, how deplorable.
To think I'd end up coming here
with someone like this...
rows.notes: Both genders: 'someone like this' keeps it neutral.

rows.en:
(What could it be?
It's probably not a Sheryl concert or anything...)
Do you know 'Fire Bomber'?

Yes, we covered them in class.
I think they were from the Macross 7 fleet...
rows.notes: Both genders. Trails off as the Japanese does.

rows.en:
Ahh, that's all you know?
Truly deplorable...
Uh... yeah... and so...

Listen up!
Today's a 'Fire Bomber' concert!

Oh, is that so... wait, WHAT?!
You mean they're here? That legendary band?!
Well, mind you, it's a hologram concert.
Oh, is that right... That's a bit of a letdown.

Even so, a chance to see 'Fire Bomber' songs
at full blast, with visuals, in a place like this
doesn't come around often, y'know.
I see. But yeah, that does sound amazing!

You bet. You won't regret it, guaranteed.
Today we're going all out!
Haah~ That was amazing...
See? Aren't you glad you came?

Yes, it was the absolute best!
'Fire Bomber' is incredible!

Obviously.
Geez, kids these days don't even know that much...

'Burning Fire' especially,
that one was just the best!

Right?! That one was, uh...
I think it was used as the opening for some game...

I see, now I'm really interested.
I'll try listening to more of their stuff!
Well, then it was worth bringing you along.

Yep, I think I'll have sweet dreams tonight.
See ya!
(Gary-sensei's got a pretty good side to him...)

(Gary-sensei said 'Today it's the Sky Gate!'...
I wonder if something's going on?)
Wh-what... um... and so...

Yes, now I'm really interested.
I'll try listening to more of their stuff!

uncertain: c05269/c05270: Gary scores passers-by (85, 120 points); the scene implies women ('oneechan' earlier) but no one is named, so 'that one'/'this one' stays neutral.
c05282: answers a player question not repeated in this repeat visit; read as the player's 'what are we doing today?' (c05251).
c05298-c05313: double-bracketed band and song names kept as single quotes ('Fire Bomber', 'Burning Fire').
